thread:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed a broken sidebar link under Runtime -> Cache. It points to /docs/internals/cache.md and returns 404. Can someone own a quick fix? cc @Maria
Maria: On it, I can take a look tonight and open a PR if it's just a path change.
Sam: Thanks. Do we want a redirect or update the link to the current path? Not sure which is canonical.
Alex: I think the canonical moved file might be /docs/runtime/cache.md (we had a rename last quarter). Redirect is safest if it's a rename.
Maria: Doing a quick repo scan now. `git grep "internals/cache.md" -- docs || true` — looks like the actual file lives at `docs/runtime/cache.md` but there was an intermediate `docs/runtime/cacheing.md` typo in one commit. I'll update the sidebar to point to `docs/runtime/cache.md` and add a redirect for the old path.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: Noted. Creating a draft change in the docs repo for review.
Jules: Quick thing — the cache doc says "KV cache TTL = 0.5s" in the performance notes. I think that number is off (maybe 50ms). @Maria can you verify while you're editing? :eyes:
Maria: Good catch, I'll double-check the measurement in the doc and ping eng-ml if we need to confirm. If it's a typo I'll fix it in the same PR.
Alex: If it's just a text fix go ahead. If it's a behavior/metric change, loop in @Sam for signoff.
Sam: Yup — if it's changing expected perf values ping me. Otherwise small doc fix + redirect is fine. Also please add a short changelog entry and `docs:fix` label on the PR.
Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487 — sidebar path fixed, redirect added, TTL note corrected (noted as editorial change). @Sam please review when you have a minute :pray:
Sam: :thumbsup: Reviewing now.
Alex: Can we also add a tiny note in the changelog about the redirect so external links don't surprise people? And @Jules any CDN concerns?
Jules: CDN redirect TTL is fine (7d) — no action needed on infra. Changelog entry on the PR suffices.
docs-bot: CI: checks passed. Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-487--docs.redwood.ai
Maria: Thanks all. I'll merge after @Sam gives LGTM and then I'll post a short notice in #eng-notices so folks with bookmarks know about the redirect.
Sam: LGTM, merged. Thanks @Maria! :shipit:
